metadata.title: Configure CI Pipeline with Quality Gates

story.iWant: CI pipeline configured with automated quality gates
story.soThat: code quality is enforced on every commit and pull request
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Create GitHub Actions workflow file (AC: #1-5) - [ ] Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` - [ ] Configure triggers (push/PR to main) - [ ] Add steps: checkout, setup python, install deps - [ ] Add quality checks: pytest, mypy, ruff, pip-audit
- [ ] Task 2: Configure pytest in pyproject.toml (AC: #6) - [ ] Add markers for validation layers - [ ] Configure test discovery
- [ ] Task 3: Configure coverage in pyproject.toml (AC: #6) - [ ] Set source paths and omit patterns - [ ] Configure report settings
- [ ] Task 4: Configure mypy in pyproject.toml (AC: #6) - [ ] Enable strict mode - [ ] Configure warnings
- [ ] Task 5: Configure ruff in pyproject.toml (AC: #6) - [ ] Select all rules (ALL) - [ ] Configure ignores (ANN101, ANN102)
- [ ] Task 6: Add CI badge to README (AC: #7) - [ ] Update README.md if exists
- [ ] Task 7: Test CI pipeline locally - [ ] Run all checks manually
- [ ] Task 8: Commit and verify CI runs - [ ] Push changes and check GitHub Actions

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **GitHub Actions workflow created** - Automates quality checks on push/PR.
2. **Test coverage enforced** - Fail if coverage < 80%.
3. **Type safety enforced** - Mypy strict mode, no errors allowed.
4. **Code quality enforced** - Ruff linter with comprehensive rules.
5. **Security enforced** - Pip-audit for vulnerabilities.
6. **Local development tools configured** - pyproject.toml updated.
7. **CI badge added** - README shows build status.

doc.title: Architecture - Testing Strategy
doc.snippet: Quality Gates: - Coverage: 80% minimum - Typing: Strict mode - Linting: Comprehensive (Ruff) - Security: Dependency auditing

tests.standards: Verify all checks pass locally. Verify workflow syntax is valid.

ideas.idea: Run `act` to simulate GitHub Actions locally.
